title: M-ONT 2027 — Workshop & School on Oligonucleotide and RNA Therapeutics
organizers: Victoria Calzada, Juan Pablo Tosar, Pablo D. Dans
summary: Four days on the chemistry, biology and clinical use of antisense oligonucleotides, siRNAs, aptamers and emerging RNA therapies, with introductory lectures, invited talks, posters and case studies.

title: Aptamers in Biotechnology: Principles and Applications
location: Facultad de Ciencias (UdelaR) & Nuclear Research Center, Montevideo, Uruguay
summary: 80-hour course (online theory followed by a week of in-person practicals) training researchers to develop and apply aptamer-based biotechnologies.

title: Biomolecular Modeling School (EMB) 2027
location: FCEN, University of Buenos Aires, Argentina
organizers: Darío Estrin, Luciana Capece, Mariano González Lebrero, Uriel Morzan, Ari Zeida, Pablo D. Dans
summary: Two-week theoretical and hands-on school: electronic structure, force fields, molecular dynamics, QM/MM, free-energy methods, machine learning, drug design and coarse-grained models.

title: Molecular Phylogenetics and Protein Modeling
organizers: German Traglia, Samuel Miño, Pablo D. Dans
summary: Postgraduate course combining molecular phylogenetics with protein structure modeling.

title: Introduction to Microbiology
location: CENUR Litoral Norte, University of the Republic, Uruguay
organizers: German Traglia, Andrea Texo, Oscar Irabuena, Alexandra Bozzo, Pablo D. Dans
